64.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.

65.description: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

66.description: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
66.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

67.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
67.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

68.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
68.effect:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

69.description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
69.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

70.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

71.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
71.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

72.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
72.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

73.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
73.effect:
Plants a seed on the target that drains 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn and heals the user for the amount taken. Has no effect on Grass Pokémon. The seed remains until the target leaves the field.

The user takes damage instead of being healed if the target has Liquid Ooze.

Rapid Spin will remove this effect.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

74.description: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
74.effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each. During Sunny Day, raises both stats by two stages.

75.description: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
75.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

76.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
76.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

77.description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

78.description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

79.description: The user scatters a cloud of soporific dust that puts the target to sleep.

80.description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
80.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

81.description: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.
81.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

82.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

83.description: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
83.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

84.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
84.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

85.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
85.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

86.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

87.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
87.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

88.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

89.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
89.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

90.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
90.effect:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

91.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
91.effect:
Inflicts regular damage. User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Earthquake, Fissure, and Magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

92.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
92.effect: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

93.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.
93.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

94.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
94.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

95.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

96.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
96.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

97.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
97.effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

98.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

99.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
99.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage.

100.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.
100.effect: Does nothing. Wild battles end immediately.

101.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
101.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

102.description: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.
102.effect:
This move is replaced by the target’s last successfully used move, and its PP changes to 5. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if the user already knows the targeted move, this move will fail. This effect vanishes when the user leaves the field.

If Chatter, Metronome, Mimic, Sketch, or Struggle is selected, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

103.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.
103.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

104.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
104.effect: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

105.description: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
105.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

106.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.
106.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

107.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness.
107.effect:
Raises the user’s evasion by two stages.

Stomp and Steamroller have double power against Pokémon that have used this move since entering the field.

108.description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.
108.effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

109.description: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

110.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.
110.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

111.description: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.
111.effect:
Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

After this move is used, the power of Ice Ball and Rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field.

112.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
112.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

113.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.
113.effect:
Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from special attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier.

If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns.

Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

114.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
114.effect:
Removes stat, accuracy, and evasion modifiers from every Pokémon on the field.

This does not count as a stat reduction for the purposes of Clear Body or White Smoke.

115.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.
115.effect:
Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier.

If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns.

Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

116.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.
116.effect:
User’s critical hit rate is two levels higher until it leaves the field. If the user has already used Focus Energy since entering the field, this move will fail.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

117.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
117.effect:
User waits for two turns. On the second turn, the user inflicts twice the damage it accumulated on the last Pokémon to hit it. Damage inflicted is typeless.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

118.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
118.effect:
Selects any move at random and uses it. Moves the user already knows are not eligible. Assist, meta, protection, and reflection moves are also not eligible; specifically, Assist, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Quick Guard, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, and Wide Guard will not be selected by this move.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

119.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
119.effect:
Uses the last move targeted at the user by a Pokémon still on the field. A move counts as targeting the user even if it hit multiple Pokémon, as long as the user was one of them; however, moves targeting the field itself do not count. If the user has not been targeted by an appropriate move since entering the field, or if no Pokémon that targeted the user remains on the field, this move will fail.

Moves that failed, missed, had no effect, or were blocked are still copied.

Assist moves, time-delayed moves, “meta” moves that operate on other moves/Pokémon/abilities, and some other special moves cannot be copied and are ignored; if the last move to hit the user was such a move, the previous move will be used instead. The full list of ignored moves is: Acid Armor, Acupressure, After You, Agility, Ally Switch, Amnesia, Aqua Ring, Aromatherapy, Aromatic Mist, Assist, Autotomize, Barrier, Baton Pass, Belch, Belly Drum, Bide, Bulk Up, Calm Mind, Camouflage, Celebrate, Charge, Coil, Conversion, Conversion 2, Copycat, Cosmic Power, Cotton Guard, Counter, Crafty Shield, Curse, Defend Order, Defense Curl, Destiny Bond, Detect, Doom Desire, Double Team, Dragon Dance, Electric Terrain, Endure, Final Gambit, Flower Shield, Focus Energy, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Future Sight, Geomancy, Grassy Terrain, Gravity, Growth, Grudge, Guard Split, Hail, Happy Hour, Harden, Haze, Heal Bell, Heal Order, Heal Pulse, Healing Wish, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hone Claws, Howl, Imprison, Ingrain, Ion Deluge, Iron Defense, King’s Shield, Light Screen, Lucky Chant, Lunar Dance, Magic Coat, Magnet Rise, Magnetic Flux, Mat Block, Me First, Meditate, Metronome, Milk Drink, Mimic, Minimize, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Mist, Misty Terrain, Moonlight, Morning Sun, Mud Sport, Nasty Plot, Nature Power, Perish Song, Power Split, Power Trick, Protect, Psych Up, Quick Guard, Quiver Dance, Rage Powder, Rain Dance, Recover, Recycle, Reflect, Reflect Type, Refresh, Rest, Rock Polish, Role Play, Roost, Rototiller, Safeguard, Sandstorm, Shadow Blast, Shadow Bolt, Shadow Half, Shadow Rush, Shadow Shed, Shadow Sky, Shadow Storm, Shadow Wave, Sharpen, Shell Smash, Shift Gear, Sketch, Slack Off, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Soft-Boiled, Spikes, Spiky Shield, Spit Up, Splash, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Stockpile, Struggle, Substitute, Sunny Day, Swallow, Swords Dance, Synthesis, Tail Glow, Tailwind, Teleport, Toxic Spikes, Transform, Water Sport, Wide Guard, Wish, Withdraw and Work Up.

This move cannot be selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk, nor forced by Encore.

120.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
120.effect: User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

121.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

122.description: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
122.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

123.description: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.
123.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

124.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
124.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

125.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.
125.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

126.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
126.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

127.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
127.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
